name: One Week in Weeping Pine
source:
One Week in Weeping Pine is a yuri/GL visual novel where you play as a trans woman returning to her hometown after thirteen years away.

Over the course of five days, you'll decide who to spend time with, who to prioritize, and ultimately, the direction the protagonist's life will go after this week.

[From [url=https://alimakesrpgs.itch.io/one-week-in-weeping-pine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《哭泣松树一周》是一部yuri/GL视觉小说，你将扮演一名跨性别女性，在离开十三年后回到家乡。

在五天的时间里，你将决定与谁共度时光，优先考虑谁，以及最终主角本周生活的方向。

[来自[url=https://alimakesrpgs.itch.io/one-week-in-weeping-pine]itch.io[/url]]
